name: Breastfeeding Tracker & Timer
tagline: A simple timer for your newborn’s first feeds.
shortDescription: A forgiving breastfeeding timer for the first weeks, with one-handed tracking, widgets, editable history, and PDF export.
longDescription: In the first few weeks, feeds can blur together. Breastfeeding Tracker & Timer starts with one hand, remembers the last side, keeps the current feed within reach, and lets you correct anything you forgot when the moment is quieter.

seoContent.heading: A breastfeeding timer for your newborn’s first weeks
paragraphs: The early weeks can make one feed feel like it happened moments ago when hours have passed. Start with one hand, see the last side used, and keep the timer visible on iPhone, Apple Watch, the Home Screen, Lock Screen, or Dynamic Island.
If your baby latched before you remembered to start, move the recorded time back. If a feed is already over, add it from history. The record can stay useful without being exact to the second.

Review private on-device summaries for visible patterns or export selected feeds as a PDF for a midwife or feeding-support conversation. Summaries remain informational, and the PDF only reflects what you recorded.

faqIntro: Practical answers about timing first feeds, correcting missed entries, and keeping a useful record without medical interpretation.

faqs.question: Is the app designed for a newborn’s first feeds?
faqs.answer: Yes. Its quick left and right timer, recent history, widgets, and Apple Watch controls are designed to reduce the memory load of the first few weeks. You can keep using it for as long as it remains helpful.

faqs.question: Can I use this breastfeeding tracker on Apple Watch?
faqs.answer: Yes. The app includes an Apple Watch companion app so you can start and stop feeds from your wrist, with active sessions and completed feeds syncing back to iPhone.

faqs.question: Does the Apple Watch app work offline?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can use the watch app when your watch is offline, and the app syncs feeds when your iPhone reconnects.

faqs.question: Does it show a live breastfeeding timer on the Lock Screen?
faqs.answer: Yes. The app supports Live Activities on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island so you can keep an eye on an active feeding timer and the current side.

faqs.question: Can I see my recent feed history and last side used?
faqs.answer: Yes. Feed history includes timestamps, duration, and side used, and the main screen highlights the last feed summary and the last side used for faster repeat logging.

faqs.question: Can I review or share my recent feed history?
faqs.answer: Yes. Private on-device summaries can help you review visible patterns, and you can export selected feeds as a PDF for a midwife or feeding-support conversation. The summaries do not assess feeding, and the PDF only reflects what you recorded.

privacySummary: Breastfeeding Tracker & Timer is designed with privacy in mind. A dedicated privacy policy is available for full details.
